statement: A party resisting restoration of possession under a partition decree must demonstrate a legally valid derivative title.
supporting_quote: The requirement that the respondent demonstrate a legally valid derivative title ensures that the protection afforded by the proviso operates only where the respondent has a genuine claim derived from the decree holder.

statement: A party who claims prescriptive title must demonstrate possession over a specifically identified corpus; failure to do so renders such a claim untenable, as a prescription cannot operate over an uncertain or unidentified land.
supporting_quote: A person who claims a prescriptive title must demonstrate possession over a specifically identified corpus; failure to do so renders such a claim untenable, as a prescription cannot operate over an uncertain or unidentified land.

statement: A rightful owner of a property who was dispossessed by illegal means has the right to obtain an order from court for eviction and restoration.
supporting_quote: A rightful owner of a property who was dispossessed by illegal means has the right to obtain an order from court for eviction and restoration.

statement: Section 27B(1) does not apply with retrospective effect.
supporting_quote: He accordingly submitted that as the Order under Section 14(2) was made in June 1974 and Deed No. 2085, by which the Plaintiff derived her title, was executed in 1980, prior to Act No. 39 of 1981, the provisions of Section 27B has no application in this case.

statement: The termination of the Lease Agreement does not prevent the plaintiff from claiming the defendants the total rent payable under the Lease Agreement for the full term of the lease.
supporting_quote: I hold that the termination of the Lease Agreement does not prevent the plaintiff from claiming the defendants the total rent payable under the Lease Agreement for the full term of the lease.

statement: A court investigating title in a partition action must consider the entirety of the evidence as to the devolution of title of the parties to the land sought to be partitioned.
supporting_quote: Therefore, it is clear that the learned District Judge had carefully considered the entirety of the evidence as to the devolution of title of the parties to the land sought to be partitioned as required under Section 25(1) of the Partition Law.

statement: A rei vindicatio action proper requires proof of title, but an action against an overholding lessee or licensee is based on privity of contract and issues as to title are irrelevant.
supporting_quote: What has been discussed above indicate the deference between the re vidicatio action and an acton against an overholding lessee or licensee.

statement: Specific performance will not be granted where the contract is impossible of performance.
supporting_quote: specific performance will not be granted where the contract is impossible of performance

statement: A settlement must be notified to the court by motion made in the presence of, or on notice to, all the parties concerned, and the court shall pass a decree in accordance therewith, so far as it relates to the action.
supporting_quote: such agreement, compromise, or satisfaction shall be notified to the court by motion made in presence of, or on notice to, all the parties concerned, and the court shall pass a decree in accordance therewith, so far as it relates to the action, and such decree shall be final, so far as relates to so much of the subject-matter of the action as is dealt with by the agreement, compromise, or satisfaction.

statement: A tenant cannot refuse to surrender possession if they have made unauthorized constructions without obtaining permission from the landlord.
supporting_quote: Any tenant or occupier who acts contrary to above has to suffer the legal consequences.

statement: The High Court cannot set aside an arbitral award on grounds not specified in the Arbitration Act, and must make a finding based on the application and material contained therein.
supporting_quote: A finding cannot be made by the High Court in terms of sub paragraph (b) of section 32 (1) other than on the averments of the application and the material contained therein.

statement: Section 161 of the Land Development Ordinance does not apply to land alienated on a Grant, and therefore the defendant cannot acquire prescriptive title to the plaintiff's land.
supporting_quote: The Legislature has not extended that protection to land alienated on a Grant.

statement: A mere discrepancy between the traditional Sinhala measures of land and the actual extent of the land does not necessarily lead to the conclusion that the corpus in a partition action is not identified.
supporting_quote: A mere discrepancy between this system of measure and the actual extent of the corpus does not necessarily lead to the conclusion that the corpus in a partition action is not identified.

statement: When one builds a house on another's land, the house goes with the soil.
supporting_quote: Since the Defendant has built the house on the land belonging to the Plaintiff, the house goes to the land with the Plaintiff. Accession was a primary mode of acquisition of property recognized by the Civil law1 . Exceptions were admitted in regard to movable property for cogent reasons of policy2 , but as far as land was concerned, it was an absolute principle that structures and plantations acceded to the soil and enured to the benefit of the owner of the soil3 .

statement: The plaintiff must identify the land in suit with precision before the execution of the decree.
supporting_quote: If the plaintiff fails to identify the land he claims dominium over, his action must fail.

statement: Parole evidence is permitted to prove a constructive trust between parties, even if the document is contrary to Section 2 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance, if the attendant circumstances support the trust.
supporting_quote: In order to establish legal principles discussed in Section 83 of the Trust Ordinance, in my view, it is necessary to lead parole evidence between the parties. If this evidence is shut out, the purpose of Section 83 of the Trust Ordinance would be rendered nugatory.

statement: A Buddhist Vihara or Temple can be considered an institution sui generis which is capable in law of holding property.
supporting_quote: A Buddhist Vihara or temple is an institution sui generis which is capable in law of receiving and holding property.

statement: A plaintiff cannot claim a bigger land than he is entitled to under and in terms of his chain of title.
supporting_quote: Therefore, the plaintiff was certainly not claiming a bigger land than he was entitled to under and in terms of his chain of title.

statement: In a case where the party claiming a declaration of title must prove title to the corpus in dispute having identified the corpus in the first instance.
supporting_quote: It is trite law substantiated by a plethora of authorities, that in a case where the party claiming a declaration of title must prove title to the corpus in dispute having identified the corpus in the first instance.

statement: A contract by a minor is only voidable and not void, thus, the Power of Attorney remained valid until it is set aside and that subsequent setting aside of the Power of Attorney, will not affect the property rights acquired by the Petitioner as innocent third parties through the Power of Attorney.
supporting_quote: Even if an unassisted contract is void against the minor it can be ratified and make valid by the minor after becoming a major as happened in the case at hand. Once it is ratified and made valid and used for his benefit, he is estopped from stating that it is void ab initio.

statement: Courts should not permit appeals from preliminary rulings, such as orders on jurisdictional objections, as it would reintroduce procedural delays and uncertainties that the Act was enacted to eliminate.
supporting_quote: To permit appeals from preliminary rulings, such as orders on jurisdictional objections, would invite a reintroduction of precisely the procedural delays and uncertainties that the Act was enacted to eliminate.

statement: A Christian deponent is required to take an oath that the material contained in the affidavit is within his personal knowledge and thereafter proceed to state the factual matters.
supporting_quote: It was his position that if the person who makes an affidavit is a Christian, such person who is known as a deponent, is required to state so at the beginning of the affidavit, is required to take an oath that the material contained in such affidavit is within his personal knowledge and thereafter proceed to state the factual matters.

statement: A party cannot be expected to pay the balance of a purchase price without receiving a title deed.
supporting_quote: There was no way to pay the balance and get title from the Plaintiffs simply because they did not have legal title to the said housing unit until the end of 2002.

statement: A court must be vigilant and cautious when granting interim relief that prevents the continuation of a bank's statutory enforcement process, particularly where the plaintiffs have not placed material sufficient to establish a sustainable claim.
supporting_quote: It is well-settled law that the right of a licensed commercial bank to realise mortgaged property by parate execution under the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act is a substantive statutory right which cannot be lightly interfered with by Court.

statement: A co-owner's signature on an amicable partition plan is not sufficient to terminate co-ownership in relation to divided portions depicted in the plan.
supporting_quote: Such placement of signature can only be construed as co-owner’s expression of consent and willingness to transfer or renounce their rights in relation to the lots allocated to the other co-owners but such plan itself cannot be construed as an instrument or writing renouncing or transferring such co-owned rights.
